document.text: A clinic has a single injector of epinephrine. Sora needs the epinephrine. Malik needs the epinephrine. Dr. Reed must give the injector to either Sora or Malik, but not both. If Dr. Reed gives the injector to Sora, Sora will survive. If Dr. Reed gives the injector to Malik, Malik will survive.
